none: PAS NLM-E8C771: Roman Coin: Nummus of Magnentius
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Magnentius, Emperor standing left issue of 350-351, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Large bare headed bust draped right; legend possibly trimmed from coin. Reverse description: Emperor standing left holding standard and Victory on globe. Reverse inscription: [FELICITAS REI PVBLICAE]. Cliff Reeves kindly examined this coin. Diameter: 19.7mm, Weight: 2.90gms, die axis: 12
